highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.subtitle: The features that make Sirius stand out from every other CRM

kanban.name: Kanban Pipeline
kanban.description: Visualize deals in clear stages with drag-and-drop. Create multiple customized pipelines by product, region, or team. See total value per stage and closing forecast in real time.

whatsapp.name: Integrated WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Connect your WhatsApp via Evolution API with QR Code pairing. Send and receive messages directly from the CRM. Unified inbox with tags, quick replies, conversation assignment, and media (photos, audio, documents).

agi.name: AGI Sirius — AI Sales Assistant
agi.description: Artificial Intelligence that analyzes your deals, generates personalized sales scripts, diagnoses deal health, enriches contacts, and recommends next actions. Based on Knowledge Graph with RAG.

maps.name: Google Maps Prospecting
maps.description: Find leads automatically via Google Maps. Search by segment and location, and Sirius extracts name, phone, email, website, and address. Monthly credits per plan — from 75 to 1,500 leads/month.

automations.name: Deal Automations
automations.description: Create automations by triggers: deal created, moved to a stage, won, lost, or stale for X days. Actions: send email, send WhatsApp, create task, or update field. Full execution logs.

analytics.name: PRO Analytics
analytics.description: Advanced dashboards with win rate, sales cycle, pipeline velocity, lost deal analysis, and trends. Period filters and time comparison. Revenue forecast by closing date.

crm.title: CRM Core
crm.subtitle: The foundation of your sales process: contacts, deals, pipelines, and activities

contacts.name: Contact Management
contacts.description: Full CRUD with CSV import and export. Interaction history, company association, customizable tags, and activity timeline. Up to unlimited contacts on the Business plan.

deals.name: Deals
deals.description: Track value, closing date, assignee, and stage. Linked notes, activities, and comments. Drag-and-drop in Kanban. Data export.

pipelines.name: Multiple Pipelines
pipelines.description: Create separate pipelines by product, region, or team. Configure custom stages, set a default pipeline, and link specific automations per pipeline.

tasks.name: Activities & Tasks
tasks.description: Create tasks linked to deals and contacts. Set assignees, deadlines, and reminders. Automatically sync with Google Calendar.

comunicacao.title: Multi-channel Communication
comunicacao.subtitle: WhatsApp, email, and notifications — all integrated without leaving the CRM

inbox.name: Unified Inbox (WhatsApp)
inbox.description: All WhatsApp conversations in one place. Filter by tags, search by name, pin important chats, archive old conversations. Assign conversations to team members.

quickReplies.name: Quick Replies
quickReplies.description: Create quick reply templates to speed up WhatsApp support. Access them with a single click directly from the chat.

emailAutomations.name: Email Automations
emailAutomations.description: Automatic email campaigns: welcome, deal created, stage change, upgrade nudge. Templates with dynamic variables (name, value, company). Open and click analytics.

notifications.name: Real-Time Notifications
notifications.description: Push notifications (PWA) for new deals, won deals, WhatsApp messages, and calendar reminders. SSE streaming for instant browser updates.

ia.title: Artificial Intelligence (AGI Sirius)
ia.subtitle: Sales AI that analyzes, suggests, and enriches your data automatically

dealAnalysis.name: AI Deal Analysis
dealAnalysis.description: AGI Sirius analyzes each deal and generates a closing probability score, identifies risks, and suggests actions to increase conversion.

scripts.name: Sales Script Generator
scripts.description: AI generates personalized call and outreach scripts based on the contact's profile, deal stage, and interaction history.

enrichment.name: Contact Enrichment
enrichment.description: AI automatically supplements your contacts' data: job title, company, social media, and relevant information for your sales approach.

rag.name: Knowledge Graph + RAG
rag.description: Graph-based knowledge system that extracts entities and relationships from your data and blog. Semantic queries via Retrieval-Augmented Generation.

insights.name: Insights & Recommendations
insights.description: Receive automatic insights about your pipeline: bottlenecks, opportunities, trends, and next-step recommendations based on historical data.

prospeccao.title: Automatic Prospecting
prospeccao.subtitle: Find new customers effortlessly with automatic Google Maps search

search.name: Google Maps Search
search.description: Type the segment (e.g., "pizzerias") and city. Sirius automatically searches Google Maps and returns: name, phone, email, website, address, and rating.

credits.name: Credits System
credits.description: Each plan includes monthly prospecting credits: Starter 75, Pro 300, Business 1,500. Buy extra packs of 100 or 500 leads when needed.

conversion.name: Automatic Contact Conversion
conversion.description: Found leads can be converted into CRM contacts with one click. Search history saved for future reference.

analytics.title: Analytics & BI
analytics.subtitle: Dashboards that show the real health of your sales operation

dashboard.name: Sales Dashboard
dashboard.description: Total pipeline value, conversion rate, average ticket, closing forecast, and deals per stage. Consolidated view of the entire sales operation.

advanced.name: Advanced Analytics
advanced.description: Win rate, average sales cycle, pipeline velocity, trends over time. Custom period filters and period-over-period comparison.

lostDeals.name: Lost Deal Analysis
lostDeals.description: Understand why deals are lost. Categorize reasons, identify patterns, and adjust your sales process with data.

marketing.name: Marketing & CAC
marketing.description: Integrate with Google Ads and Meta Ads to calculate CAC automatically. Track campaign ROI, LTV/CAC ratio, and cost per lead with manual or automatic entry.

integracoes.title: Integrations
integracoes.subtitle: Connect Sirius to your entire tool ecosystem

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp (Evolution API)
whatsapp.description: Native integration with Evolution API. Multi-instance on Business (up to 5). QR Code for pairing, message sending/receiving, media, and real-time status.

calendar.name: Google Calendar
calendar.description: Sync activities and meetings with Google Calendar via OAuth. Automatically create events from deals. Receive appointment reminders.

ads.name: Google Ads & Meta Ads
ads.description: Connect your ad accounts to import campaign metrics, spend, and conversions. Calculate CAC and ROI automatically.

n8n.name: n8n
n8n.description: Integrate with n8n to create advanced automation workflows. Connect Sirius to hundreds of tools via custom nodes.

webhooks.name: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Configure webhooks to receive real-time events: deal created, contact updated, deal won/lost. Signing secrets for security. Execution logs with automatic retry.

api.name: REST API v1
api.description: Public API documented for developers. Manage contacts, deals, pipelines, and webhooks programmatically. API keys with configurable permissions.

equipe.title: Team Management
equipe.subtitle: Tools for sales teams to work together efficiently

management.name: Team Management
management.description: Invite members by email, manage roles (Owner/Member), and control permissions. View pending invitations and team activity.

roundRobin.name: Lead Round-Robin
roundRobin.description: Automatically distribute new leads among salespeople in rotation. Skip offline users, notify about new assignments, and ensure balanced distribution.

assignment.name: Conversation Assignment
assignment.description: In WhatsApp chat, assign conversations to specific team members. Each salesperson only sees their assigned chats.

mobile.title: Mobile & Field
mobile.subtitle: Close deals from anywhere with the complete mobile experience

pwa.name: PWA (Progressive Web App)
pwa.description: Install Sirius on your phone's home screen like a native app. Works offline for basic queries. Push notifications even with the app closed.

gps.name: GPS Check-in
gps.description: For field sales reps: check in to visits with GPS location. Visit history with map, times, and notes. Mobile-optimized interface.

offline.name: Offline Sync
offline.description: Your data is available even without internet. When the connection comes back, everything syncs automatically.

seguranca.title: Security & Compliance
seguranca.subtitle: Your data protected with the highest security standards

encryption.name: Data Encryption
encryption.description: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. Your data is isolated per organization.

sso.name: SSO & Audit Log
sso.description: Single Sign-On for corporate login and a complete audit log of all actions on the platform. Business plan.

apiKeys.name: API Keys with Permissions
apiKeys.description: Create API keys with defined scope. Revoke at any time. Webhook signing secrets to validate request origin.
